confidence_rule.decision: At each method and budget require both scientific equivalence and performance. Performance uses exact one-sided binomial order-statistic lower confidence bound for median paired baseline/method GPU-second ratio; require bound > 1.05. Equivalence uses exact two-sided order-statistic confidence intervals of median candidate-minus-baseline energy differences, with Bonferroni over two metrics (per-metric alpha=0.025, per-tail alpha=0.0125); require entire interval strictly inside [-abs_margin,+abs_margin]. Lack of significance never establishes equivalence. Missing values, failed replicas, timeouts or infinite confidence bounds fail.
confidence_rule.finite_sample_details: For eight seeds the two-sided equivalence interval is [minimum, maximum] of the eight paired differences: each tail probability 1/256 = 0.00390625 <= 0.0125. For ten timing pairs the one-sided 95% performance lower bound is second smallest paired ratio, since P(Binomial(10,0.5)<=1)=11/1024 <= 0.05 and P(<=2)=56/1024 > 0.05. Report ties conservatively.
confidence_rule.multiplicity_scope: Each method/budget is a separately reported prospective comparison. Bonferroni covers both scientific metrics within that comparison; no family-wide method-selection confidence claim.

evidence_limits: Measured baseline ensemble wall time 59.06967849900002 s and throughput 1170.143494198468 ns/day are one run, not method results. Profile total wall 64.873516666 s is a distinct profiled run; no pooled baseline time estimate assumed.
Profile MPS throughput factors are whole-workload headroom ceilings. No method implementation, speed measurement, launch/merge breakdown or numeric energy-versus-budget curve exists.

Energy time series unavailable. Statistical equivalence of median paired mean and final potential energies does not establish trajectory identity, equilibrium convergence or all-replica maximum-error equivalence.
No gate scripts supplied: intake/EXECUTION.json gate_scripts is null. No external gates, builds or workloads executed. Scope or tolerance changes require new sealed run.

hardware_cost_basis.accounting: Charge one allocated GPU times complete elapsed ensemble wall time, including GPU-idle host launch, transfer and merge periods. Shared MPS workers collectively occupy one GPU, not one GPU each. Same device, driver 570.148.08 and software for both arms.

infeasible_methods.reason: Only one GPU; equal-GPU-second Amdahl/k bound 1.0 < 1.05.
Transfer fraction 0.004130463017454412 with k=2 gives Amdahl ceiling 1.002069505516728 < 1.05; launch/transfer/merge overhead further reduces gain.

paired_seed_tests.assumptions: Eight seed streams treated as independent exchangeable scientific replicates; same initial coordinates, velocity seed and Langevin seed in both arms. Fixed seeds ensure reproducible pairing, not deterministic scientific outputs.
paired_seed_tests.description: For each metric, pair candidate minus sequential baseline by input and seed. In each timing pair retain eight seed differences; reduce repeated timing-pair differences to one median per seed before inference. Repeated executions of a fixed seed are not independent scientific samples. Test median paired energy differences, not trajectory identity.

power.derivation: With n=8 and two metrics, Bonferroni 95% equivalence uses min/max seed differences. If independent seeds each fall strictly inside each metric margin with probability at least 0.99, joint pass probability >= 1-2*(1-0.99^8) = 0.8454893888558401. This is an explicit prospective near-equivalence assumption, not estimated power.
power.limitation: Paired-difference distribution and same-seed baseline repeatability unavailable. Baseline across-seed SD does not estimate paired-difference variance; empirical power cannot be certified. No seed expansion or tolerance adaptation after seeing method outputs.

scheduling_details: At each sealed method/budget run ten baseline/method pairs; independently randomize AB or BA using fixed scheduling PRNG seed 731029 in listed method and budget order. Execute arms sequentially with no other GPU workload; within each arm concurrency remains fixed at four maximum. Do not discard slow successful pairs or alter order based on observed times.

splits.justification: One published molecular configuration, no training split. All eight seeds already occur in baseline evidence; no claim of held-out seeds or unseen molecular systems. No tuning on evaluation outcomes or seed selection.

timing_scope.description: Common ensemble wall timer begins before any arm-specific worker launch or first Context creation and ends after all eight replicas complete, GPU synchronization, Context destruction, seed-ordered result merge and worker shutdown. Includes launch, initialization, kernel compilation under fixed cache policy, H2D/D2H transfer, integration, energy queries and merge. Common imports, argument parsing, PDB/force-field loading and System construction precede timer; final output serialization follows timer. No sum of per-replica times. MPS daemon provisioned before both arms and kept fixed; daemon startup excluded for both. Baseline and method must implement identical outer timing boundaries.

warmup_protocol: One complete untimed eight-replica ensemble per arm before each method/budget timing block. Preserve seeds and work. Reset trajectories between runs; retain warmed CUDA compilation cache consistently. Do not count warmup as scientific samples or timing pairs. No adaptive warmup.
